meta_title: D W Gas & Heating | Plumber Sunderland
meta_description: D W Gas & Heating in Sunderland. Gas Safe registered plumber offering boiler repairs, installations, and emergency callouts. Fast, reliable service. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Sunderland? We attend emergency calls day and night, arriving within the hour.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full boiler installations, we handle all your gas and heating needs with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Heating broken down? We diagnose and repair most faults same day, carrying parts on the van to minimise your time without heat.

services.title: Boiler Installations & Replacements
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year manufacturer warranty. We advise on efficiency ratings and help you choose the right model for your home.

services.title: Central Heating Powerflush
services.desc: Restore circulation and reduce energy bills with a professional powerflush. Removes sludge and improves radiator performance across your system.

services.title: Pipe Burst & Leak Repairs
services.desc: Frozen or burst pipes in winter? We trace the fault, repair or replace the pipework, and pressure-test the system to prevent future leaks.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Balancing
services.desc: New radiators fitted and balanced so every room heats evenly. We also remove and replace old units with minimal disruption.

services.title: Gas Safety Inspections & Certificates
services.desc: Annual gas safety checks for landlords and homeowners. Full report and certificate issued same day if everything passes.

about_pullquote: We treat every customer's home as if it were our own family's.
about_para_1: D W Gas & Heating has served Sunderland and the surrounding region for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that honest pricing and reliable workmanship should never be a luxury, we've built a reputation for turning up when we say we will and fixing the job properly the first time. All our engineers are Gas Safe registered and fully trained in the latest heating systems.
about_para_2: We're known locally for keeping our call-out charges transparent and refusing to oversell unnecessary work. Whether you need an emergency repair at 2am or a planned boiler upgrade, you'll get the same straightforward service and fair pricing. Hundreds of Sunderland families return to us year after year because we've never let them down.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in on a Sunday morning in January. D W Gas came out within an hour, diagnosed a faulty pump, and had us back up and running by lunchtime. Professional, friendly, and the price was fair. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a pipe burst under the kitchen after a hard frost. Called D W Gas expecting a massive bill, but they found the fault quickly, fixed it properly, and even showed me how to prevent it happening again. Top blokes. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Asked them to quote for a new boiler. No pressure sales pitch, just honest advice about which model would suit our house and budget. Installation was done on time, everything tidied up, and the paperwork was all in order. Really pleased with the whole experience.
reviews.author: David K.
